Yara (eng-oncall): follow-up thread from kv-eviction postmortem. we agreed on tests but need a policy so this doesn't fall through. proposal: any change touching cache/kv must include a regression entry and a pre-merge golden. reactions?
Ibrahim (eng-ml): +1 to policy. i'll prepare a 75-prompt "eviction-guard" pack and two goldens. will label prompts with categories (long-prefix, burst, streaming). ETA 9 days.
Clare (eng-platform): policy sounds good but we should automate enforcement: CI lint rule that ensures PRs touching code under `runtime/cache` include a `regression:` entry in PR body linking a promptset or ticket. I'll add a pre-merge job `pre-merge/kv-goldens`. ETA 10 days.
Dmitri (sre): i'll own chaos microdrill and rollout checklist. scope: 25m eviction pressure + node restart + metric heatmap capture. add clear rollback thresholds for eviction-rate and tail-latency. ETA 12 days.
Yara (eng-oncall): agree on owners. let's also add a lightweight nightly load that ramps sequence length and parallel sessions for 40 minutes. Clare can own scheduling.
Ibrahim (eng-ml): for the eval harness i'll emit three metrics: semantic-drift, token-delta, inference-latency. pre-merge only fails on semantic-drift > 0.15 or latency regression > 20%. will document false-positive process.
Clare (eng-platform): sample CI snippet for pre-merge check: ```name: pre-merge-kv-goldens on: [pull_request] jobs: smoke: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v3 - run: pytest tests/regressions/test_eviction_goldens.py -k golden```
Dmitri (sre): also add a monthly "eviction-pattern review" to the oncall checklist; rotate owner between SRE and Platform.
Yara (eng-oncall): ops-bot: create tracking epic and subtasks with owners + due dates. also link postmortem.
ops-bot: Created epic EPI-3111 "kv-regression-tax-and-guards". Subtasks: EPI-3111-1 promptset & goldens (Ibrahim) due 1795920000, EPI-3111-2 CI lint + pre-merge job (Clare) due 1796000000, EPI-3111-3 chaos microdrill & runbook (Dmitri) due 1796030000, EPI-3111-4 nightly prefix/load job (Clare) due 1796033600. Postmortem linked.
Ibrahim (eng-ml): tiny ask: platform, can eval runner read prefix-length histograms so we can slice scoring by bucket? that reduces noise.
Clare (eng-platform): yes, i'll surface histograms as prometheus metrics and add buckets for [1-64,65-256,257+].
Yara (eng-oncall): decision log: enforce "regression tax" for cache/kv PRs, owners assigned, epic created, staging canary target = 14 days, full rollout = 6 weeks. reconvene in 7 days for a status update. :thumbsup:
Ibrahim (eng-ml): ack, starting curation now.
Clare (eng-platform): ack, opening branch `ci/kv-regression-tax`.
Dmitri (sre): ack, drafting runbook and drill plan.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: status check in 7 days (1795017811).
